root.label: Uneven adaptation insurance pricing study findings

events.label: Uneven adaptation insurance pricing study findings

slots.name: policy observations
slots.sentence: Drawing on more than 18 million policy observations from Citizens Property Insurance Corporation, Florida’s state-sponsored insurer of last resort, from 2002 through 2023, they track five categories of wind and water resilience upgrades: roof-to-wall attachments, roof covering materials, roof deck attachments, secondary water resistance, and opening protection such as hurricane shutters or impact windows.

slots.name: maximum discount
slots.sentence: Discounts can reach as high as 47%, translating to hundreds or even thousands of dollars in annual savings.
